# Mermaid 11.12.0

Locally hosted, pinned distribution. No runtime CDN requests are required.

- Bundle: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.12.0/dist/mermaid.min.js
- License: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.12.0/LICENSE (MIT, included)
- Usage documentation: https://mermaid.js.org/config/usage.html
- Retrieved: 2026-10-25
- SHA-256 (mermaid.min.js): 07e37dfa97b337ccc85365d57eddf99b9706f09db3b59b260d0333b23b343c4b

Only generated integer month identifiers and fixed placeholders are passed into Mermaid. Strict security mode is enabled. Existing city SVGs replace the generated node labels after layout; interactions are attached through DOM event handlers, not Mermaid click directives.
